Title: Eye Floaters: 3 Warning Signs You Shouldn't Ignore

Description:
Seeing specks or cobwebs drift across your vision? Most eye floaters come from harmless age-related changes in the vitreous. But a sudden flood of new floaters, flashes of light, or a curtain-like shadow can signal a retinal tear - here's how the causes differ and when to see an eye doctor right away.

Ever notice specks or cobwebs drifting across your vision? 👁️

Most floaters come from harmless age-related changes in the eye's vitreous gel. But flashes of light or a curtain-like shadow over part of your vision are different - those can signal a retinal tear.

Screen breaks and sunglasses outdoors help protect your eyes too.
